# PSE&G Wins Prestigious Reliability Award for 25th Consecutive Year


## Recognizing PSE&G's ongoing work to strengthen the electric system New Jersey depends on, PA Consulting honored the utility with the following 2026 ReliabilityOne® Awards:
*- Outstanding Reliability Performance in the Mid-Atlantic Region for the 25th consecutive year - National ReliabilityOne® System Resiliency Award*


(NEWARK, N.J., Nov. 23, 2026) – Public Service Electric & Gas (PSE&G) has received two prestigious awards from PA Consulting, a Jacobs Company, recognizing its electric system’s reliability and resiliency. PSE&G earned PA Consulting's 2026 ReliabilityOne® Award for Outstanding Reliability Performance in the Mid-Atlantic Region, marking the 25th consecutive year the utility has earned this recognition. PSE&G also received the national ReliabilityOne® System Resiliency Award, recognizing its efforts to strengthen the electric system and prepare for disruptions.


Together, these honors speak to PSE&G's everyday work to keep New Jersey powered, its communities resilient and its electric system ready for tomorrow.


“Being recognized for 25 consecutive years is an extraordinary milestone, and one we’re deeply grateful for. It reflects the dedication behind delivering safe, reliable electric service that our customers can depend on every day,” said John Latka, senior vice president, PSE&G Electric Transmission and Distribution. “Through targeted infrastructure upgrades and year-round preparation, we’re strengthening our electric system to meet our customers’ needs today while preparing for the future. It’s a responsibility we take seriously because serving our customers, strengthening our communities and building a resilient energy future is what makes us Jersey Ready.”


The ReliabilityOne® Awards, presented annually by PA Consulting, recognize electric utilities for outstanding reliability and resiliency performance. The regional Outstanding Reliability Performance Award is based primarily on statistics measuring the frequency and duration of customer outages.


The national System Resiliency Award recognizes utilities for efforts to strengthen their electric systems against disruptions, address risks including severe weather, integrate reliability and grid modernization planning, and prepare to maintain essential service during emergencies. The award also considers how utilities evaluate the effectiveness of their resiliency efforts, with customers at the forefront of those decisions.


**Delivering Reliable Service**


Over the last decade, PSE&G has dedicated $30 billion to utility infrastructure, with nearly 75% focused on reliability and resiliency. This work included dozens of initiatives to upgrade and strengthen transmission and distribution systems throughout New Jersey, along with modernizing technology to support dependable electric service. These improvements help keep the electric system strong and the communities PSE&G serves powered and prepared.


**Putting Customers First**


PSE&G also recently ranked No. 1 in business electric customer satisfaction in the East among large utilities, according[to the J.D. Power 2026 U.S. Electric Utility Business Customer Satisfaction Study℠](https://nj.pseg.com/newsroom/newsrelease518) , moving up from No. 2 in 2025. The recognition reflects PSE&G's focus on understanding the needs of New Jersey businesses and providing reliable service and responsive support.


“Reliable service starts with a strong electric system, but it also means providing clear information, timely support and reassurance,” said Dave Johnson, senior vice president and PSE&G Chief Customer Experience Officer. “Whether we’re preparing for severe weather, keeping customers informed during an outage or helping with an everyday need, we work to make every interaction reflect the care and attention our customers deserve.”


In July,[Escalent named](https://nj.pseg.com/newsroom/newsrelease501) PSE&G the 2026 Most Trusted Utility Brand among residential customers for the third consecutive year and a 2026 Most Trusted Business Partner among business customers. These latest recognitions underscore how PSE&G works to earn customers' trust by listening to their needs, providing dependable service and showing up for the communities we call home.
